stages.name: Implement v1
stages.objective: Implement the initial requirement: a simple counter
stages.prompt: Implement app.py with a Counter class that has increment() and get_value() methods. The counter starts at 0.

stages.name: Requirement Changed
stages.prompt: The requirements have changed. You must now also support decrement() and reset() methods. Additionally, the counter should not go below 0. Update app.py accordingly.

requirement_change.from: counter with increment and get_value only
requirement_change.to: counter with increment, decrement, reset, and non-negative guard

stages.name: Verify Implementation
stages.objective: Run tests to verify the adapted implementation
stages.prompt: Run the test suite: python -m pytest tests/ -q. Report whether all tests pass.

metadata.description: Multi-stage with requirement change between stage 1 and 2
